classification.difficultyReason: Identify the right triangle in a ramp and use sine and tangent to find two lengths.

content.prompt: A ramp, $ABCDEF$, rests at an angle of $20^\circ$ to the horizontal and the highest point on the ramp is $2.5$ metres above the ground, as shown.

spec.description: Unfilled triangular-prism ramp. Ordinary source blue edges and red hidden edges use house black; hidden edges remain dashed.
spec.mathematics: The parallel triangular end faces are ACE and BDF. CE and DF are vertical; angle FBD is 20 degrees and DF is 2.5 m. Faces are ABFE, ABDC, CDFE, ACE and BDF. The viewing direction exposes ABFE and BDF; AC, CD and CE are hidden.
